summary: Runtime dependency sourced from unpinned personal GitHub fork
details: package.json declares a runtime dependency `libsignal` with the source `github:realvare/libsignal` — a bare GitHub tree reference with no tag, version, or commit SHA. On `npm install`, npm resolves this to whatever the repository's default branch currently holds, with no integrity check and no pin, and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in it. Whoever controls `github.com/realvare/libsignal` controls code that runs on every installer's machine. The surrounding package is a WhatsApp `baileys` fork; the official `libsignal` for this ecosystem is published under the WhiskeySockets organization, so this personal-account fork is also publisher-mismatched for the stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
